standard_prerequisites.name: Artinian approximation factorization
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies the input factorization k[y]_p/p^n -> D -> bar-Lambda being enlarged.

standard_prerequisites.name: Structure of algebraic field extensions in characteristic p
standard_prerequisites.use: A p-power of an algebraic element becomes separably algebraic.

standard_prerequisites.name: Henselianness of Artinian local rings
standard_prerequisites.use: D and bar-Lambda are henselian, enabling the finite etale lifting.

standard_prerequisites.name: Equivalence of finite etale extensions and separable residue extensions
standard_prerequisites.use: Produces D -> D' with residue field F(alpha^q)/F.

core_obligations: Write bar-Lambda = Lambda_q/q^n Lambda_q and let alpha in kappa(q) be the image of lambda; let F be the residue field of D.
If alpha lies in F, some x in D multiplies bar-lambda to 1 modulo the maximal ideal, so a p-divisible power q puts bar-lambda^q inside D.
If alpha is transcendental over F, take D' = (D[bar-lambda])_m; the subring is a polynomial algebra over D localized at a maximal ideal, essentially smooth, and contains bar-lambda itself.

If alpha is algebraic over F, choose a p-power q making alpha^q separably algebraic over F; by henselianness take the finite etale extension D -> D' with residue field F(alpha^q)/F and a factorization D' -> bar-Lambda; iterating the first case gives bar-lambda^{qq'} inside D' for some q'.
proof_roadmap: Residue field trichotomy; unit case; transcendental case; separable algebraic case via henselian lifting.
difficulty_reason: A case analysis with one construction per case; each case is a short explicit argument carried in the source.
